reviews.text: I've had my dogs treated at this clinic for over 15 years. Professor Stefano Hani and Dr. Lorenzo Hani are superb! Thank you ❤️

We came to them on my brother-in-law's recommendation after a terrible experience at another facility. We immediately had a great impression: the facility was very clean, and the staff assisting the doctors were always very helpful, patient, and professional. The doctors aren't separated from human life for business purposes, but have turned their passion into a way to help those of us who love animals with a dedication I never thought I'd find. They have a wealth of experience and professionalism. Their prices are very fair compared to others, and most importantly for us, they are very careful not to waste our money and time, always carefully assessing treatments and choosing the right one. Congratulations!

They are the TOP! Very good, competent, empathetic, warm, welcoming, HIGHLY PREPARED, PROFESSIONAL, I have been with them since my Ettore was 2 and a half months old and it all started with a thorn in the eye of my beloved furry friend. Everyone told me he would lose it. When I came home, one of our neighbors saw me crying and mentioned Dr. Hani (I love him, an old-fashioned professor and I adore them). I ran to him, they took Ettore under their wings and told me he would save the eye and so it was!! A miracle!!! 11 years have passed since then and I am always with them and woe betide anyone who touches them!! High-level professionals are true doctors, they are not quick to apply for money, they are not venal, on the contrary they are very scrupulous, if necessary they proceed with wise decision and years of experience and you can be sure that they will save your furry friend, Ettore is under treatment ultrasounds of everything and more with passion you feel it when they are close to you, their warmth, they update you, they explain everything to you well and if you don't understand it with a lot of patience they explain it to you again... they have too much patience with me too Hahahahhaha wonderful staff guys I adore you ..❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️💋💋💋💋

A man of unique sensitivity. He makes you feel at home with his cheerful yet always professional spirit. He understands his patients like no other. He has the same ability with people; he knows how to choose his collaborators. I adore them!
I've been going there for several years. They're the best in Rome: competent, attentive to your needs, patient, and not at all pressured by money.

I went to this clinic for a testicular ultrasound on my dog, which was necessary before a scheduled surgery at another clinic.

Over the phone, I was told the cost of the exam was €80. At the end of the visit, I repeatedly tried to pay, clearly specifying that the surgeon who would be operating on the dog worked elsewhere, but the vet decided not to charge me, claiming that this type of service was normally offered to their patients.

During the visit, I was told that the situation required prompt intervention. When I asked for the ultrasound images to provide to my surgeon, I was told they couldn't be provided because it was simply "a ball." I find this expression shameful.

My surgeon subsequently specifically requested the images. After numerous phone calls to the facility, during which the secretaries confirmed that the images were available, I was contacted again by the veterinarian, who claimed that since I hadn't paid for the ultrasound, I wasn't entitled to them. He added that I had promised to perform the procedure himself, which never happened. I was also told that providing the images would be pointless.

I found both the initial refusal to hand over the diagnostic documents and the negative comments made about my trusted surgeon particularly unprofessional.

I also perceived an unprofessional attitude during the visit. I found the birthday greetings, the jokes about him touching my hand "like in the movie Ghost," and the invitation to message him directly on WhatsApp inappropriate, despite it being the first time we'd met. Considering the decision not to charge for a service I'd been quoted and had attempted to pay for, the overall impression was one of unprofessional handling of the situation.
